truth_boundary.rule: A catalog entry is an offer definition, not evidence of a buyer, acceptance, delivery, settlement, payout, or cash. Only source-backed existing SKU terms may be marked LIVE_EXISTING_SKU.

entries.title: White Box technical hour
entries.summary: One dated White Box / dests hour for a bounded model, GGUF, agent, or systems diagnosis question.
entries.buyer_job: Get a senior technical read on one sharply bounded White Box question without buying a larger implementation engagement.
inputs: Sanitized evidence sufficient to discuss the question
deliverables: One dated White Box / dests hour
A public land/session-YYYYMMDD.md receipt describing destinations, receipts, and what ran
acceptance: The scheduled hour is delivered for the bounded question
The dated session receipt exists at the promised public path

entries.title: Agent architecture review
entries.summary: A bounded review of an agent workflow's state, tools, retries, effects, receipts, and failure boundaries.
entries.buyer_job: Turn an agent design into a decision-ready architecture with explicit failure and recovery boundaries before more implementation spend.
deliverables: Architecture findings ranked by operational consequence
Recommended state, retry, idempotency, and receipt boundaries
Concrete next-build decisions and unresolved risks
acceptance: Each material finding is tied to supplied evidence or marked as an assumption
Every recommendation names the system boundary it changes
Unknowns remain explicitly UNKNOWN

entries.title: Failure and recovery analysis
entries.summary: A technical analysis of how one workflow fails, resumes, retries, rolls back, and proves exactly-once external effects.
entries.buyer_job: Find the recovery seam that prevents a recurring automation failure from becoming duplicate work, lost state, or an unverifiable outcome.
inputs: Expected stop, resume, rollback, or effect behavior
deliverables: Binary replay or prevention test plan
acceptance: Primary and contributing causes are separated
Recovery recommendations identify state and effect boundaries
The proposed verification has a binary pass/fail result

entries.title: Computer-use design review
entries.summary: A review of a browser or desktop automation design with explicit observation, action, confirmation, recovery, and human-boundary semantics.
entries.buyer_job: Make a computer-use workflow safer and more deterministic before it is trusted with consequential UI actions.
inputs: Actions that require confirmation or human control
deliverables: Suggested deterministic checks for consequential actions
acceptance: Consequential actions are distinguished from reversible navigation
Confirmation and unknown-effect states are explicit
Recovery checks are tied to observable UI or external evidence

entries.title: Reproducibility review
entries.summary: A review of whether a result can be reproduced from pinned inputs, versions, hashes, commands, and acceptance evidence.
entries.buyer_job: Convert a one-off technical result into a repeatable evidence package another operator can verify.
acceptance: Every required dependency is pinned or marked unresolved
The verification procedure states exact expected evidence
No unavailable artifact is represented as reproduced

entries.title: Evidence architecture review
entries.summary: Design review for receipts, provenance, state transitions, and claims so operational truth remains auditable across systems.
entries.buyer_job: Know exactly what evidence must exist before a workflow can safely claim sent, accepted, delivered, paid, settled, or complete.
inputs: Required downstream audit or operator decisions
deliverables: Fail-closed rules for missing or contradictory evidence
acceptance: Each consequential claim names its required evidence
Unknown and unknown-effect states are representable
No state transition depends only on self-reported success text

entries.title: Carrier and resource routing review
entries.summary: A review of how work, credentials, receipts, and resources cross agents, connectors, runtimes, and human handoffs.
entries.buyer_job: Reduce brittle handoffs and duplicated work in a multi-agent or multi-tool operating system.
inputs: One or more known routing failures or bottlenecks
deliverables: Recommendations for receipt, credential, and retry boundaries
acceptance: Ownership is explicit at each handoff
Credential material is separated from public routing metadata
Duplicate or stale work has a deterministic resolution rule

entries.title: Muhlnickel / Titan technical consultation
entries.summary: A bounded technical consultation on Muhlnickel/Titan architecture, evaluation, machine boundaries, and keep-or-build decisions; this does not reuse the separate $45,000 build SKU as an hourly price.
entries.buyer_job: Get a decision-ready technical consultation before deciding whether a larger Muhlnickel/Titan build engagement is justified.
inputs: Relevant sanitized architecture or evaluation context
Decision that must follow the consultation
deliverables: Technical assessment tied to supplied context
Explicit unresolved assumptions and next evidence to gather
acceptance: Recommendations are separated from unknowns
The larger Titan build SKU is not represented as purchased or included
No implementation or transfer is implied unless separately scoped
